part.openingPrinciples.title: Centre, development and castling
part.openingPrinciples.summary: Each opening move develops, takes the centre or makes the king safe. Before the principle, check the concrete threat.
ex.openingPrinciples.8Mkhd: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.8Mkhd.hint: The queen must get out of the attack. Before choosing the square, check whether a white piece can trap her in front of the king.
ex.openingPrinciples.8Mkhd.solution: 8...Qe6 takes the queen out of the attack to a safe square. After 8...Qf5?, 9.Bg4 pins the queen to the king on c8, and Black loses her for the bishop.
ex.openingPrinciples.VFp8l: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.VFp8l.hint: Before recapturing, see what the black queen can attack with check.
ex.openingPrinciples.VFp8l.solution: 8.Bxc6+! captures the knight with check before recapturing on f3. After 8.Qxf3?, 8...Qb6+ gives check and attacks the bishop on b5.
ex.openingPrinciples.gN8a8: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.gN8a8.hint: The queen came out early and is attacked. Before moving her, check what the black queen attacks with check.
ex.openingPrinciples.gN8a8.solution: 9.Qe2! takes the queen out of the attack and defends the bishop on c4. After 9.Qh4?, 9...Qd4+ gives check and attacks the bishop on c4: Black wins a piece.
ex.openingPrinciples.KiNJk: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.KiNJk.hint: You are in check. Before blocking, check whether the blocking piece can be pinned to the king.
ex.openingPrinciples.KiNJk.solution: 12...Bd7 blocks, develops the bishop and attacks the queen on a4. After 12...Qc6?, 13.Bb5 pins the queen to the king, and Black loses her.
ex.openingPrinciples.AgPXG: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.AgPXG.hint: Two of your pieces are attacked by the pawn on f6. Start with a move that forces Black's reply.
ex.openingPrinciples.AgPXG.solution: 9.Bxc6+ captures with check and gains the time to save the knight on e5. After 9.Qh5+?, 9...g6 attacks the queen, and White loses a piece.
ex.openingPrinciples.Cj9Rd: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.Cj9Rd.hint: Before moving the queen, see what the knight on d4 attacks besides her.
ex.openingPrinciples.Cj9Rd.solution: 5.Nxd4! captures the knight that attacks the queen and the pawn on c2. After 5.Qh5+?, 5...g6 6.Qh4 Nxc2+ gives check and attacks the rook on a1.
ex.openingPrinciples.ffy6k: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.ffy6k.hint: Your knight on d5 is attacked twice. Count how many times it is defended before moving the queen.
ex.openingPrinciples.ffy6k.solution: 8...Nxc3 exchanges the attacked knight. After 8...Qa5?, the pin on the knight on c3 does not last: 9.Qxd5 Qxd5 10.Nxd5, and White wins a piece.
ex.openingPrinciples.WEEfA: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.WEEfA.hint: The knight on d2 looks free. Before capturing, see what the black queen reaches on your king's diagonal.
ex.openingPrinciples.WEEfA.solution: 9.b4! attacks the queen before capturing the knight on d2. After 9.Qxd2?, 9...Bb4 pins the queen to the king; after 10.axb4, 10...Qxa1+ captures the rook.
ex.openingPrinciples.kx1IX: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.openingPrinciples.kx1IX.hint: You are in check. Before capturing the pawn that gives check, see whether the capturing piece can be pinned.
ex.openingPrinciples.kx1IX.solution: 13...Ke7! steps out of check and keeps the pawn on d7 attacked. After 13...Qxd7?, 14.Bb5 pins the queen to the king, and Black loses her.
part.kingSafety.title: King safety
part.kingSafety.summary: With queens on the board, the pawn shield protects the castled king: a shield pawn only advances for a concrete reason. Without queens, the king goes to the centre.
ex.kingSafety.tshNX: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.tshNX.hint: The black queen and knight are near your king. Before advancing a shield pawn, see which square it stops watching.
ex.kingSafety.tshNX.solution: 25.Qxb7 wins a pawn and keeps the shield. After 25.f4?, which attacks the queen, 25...Ng3+ 26.hxg3 Qh5#: the f2 pawn can no longer capture on g3, and the h-file opens.
ex.kingSafety.ntsBJ: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.ntsBJ.hint: The g6 pawn stands in front of your king. Before advancing the f7 pawn, check who defends g6.
ex.kingSafety.ntsBJ.solution: 14...Bf6 offers to exchange the bishop on e5, which aims at g7. After 14...f6?, which attacks the bishop, 15.Qxg6+ Kh8 16.Qg7#: the f7 pawn used to defend g6.
ex.kingSafety.Aca6m: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.Aca6m.hint: Before attacking the knight, see what the queen and the bishop aim at.
ex.kingSafety.Aca6m.solution: 10...g6! closes the queen and bishop's diagonal to h7. After 10...h6?, which attacks the knight, 11.Bh7+ Nxh7 12.Qxh7#.
ex.kingSafety.BLSeQ: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.BLSeQ.hint: The queen on d6 and the knight on g4 aim at h2. Before attacking the knight, look at the queen's diagonal.
ex.kingSafety.BLSeQ.solution: 16.g3 closes the black queen's diagonal to h2. After 16.h3?, which attacks the knight, 16...Qh2+ 17.Kf1 Qh1#.
ex.kingSafety.xddrO: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.xddrO.hint: The queen on c2 aims at h7, and only the knight on e4 stands in the way. Look for the move that closes that diagonal before the knight leaves with check.
ex.kingSafety.xddrO.solution: 17...g6 closes the queen's diagonal to h7. After 17...h6?, which attacks the knight on g5, 18.Nf6+ Bxf6 19.Qh7#.
ex.kingSafety.lZInn: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.lZInn.hint: The f2 pawn is pinned by the bishop on a7. Before touching the shield, see who defends g3.
ex.kingSafety.lZInn.solution: 20.Rae1 activates the rook and keeps the h2 pawn next to the king. After 20.h4?, 20...Qxg3#: the f2 pawn is pinned and cannot capture.
ex.kingSafety.3mxKM: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.3mxKM.hint: The queen on c7 aims at h2. Before advancing the g2 pawn, see who defends g3.
ex.kingSafety.3mxKM.solution: 12.Re1 frees f1 for the king: after 12...Qh2+ 13.Kf1, the king escapes. After 12.g3?, which closes the diagonal, 12...Qxg3#: the f2 pawn is pinned by the bishop on c5 and cannot capture.
ex.kingSafety.OMWuw: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kingSafety.OMWuw.hint: The bishop on b7 pins the g2 pawn. Before attacking the queen, check what happens if she captures on h3.
ex.kingSafety.OMWuw.solution: 26.Kg1 takes the king off the b7 bishop's diagonal. After 26.h3?, which attacks the queen, 26...Qxh3+ 27.Kg1 Qxg2#: the g2 pawn is pinned and cannot capture on h3.
